title: Towing Parts Warehouse Closing – Entire Inventory, One Lot
description:
TOWING & TRAILER PARTS WAREHOUSE CLOSING — ENTIRE INVENTORY, ONE LOT, ASAP
Hitch receivers, winches, trailer wiring, jacks, couplers, bike carriers, roof racks, OEM dealer kits, filters — the entire towing & trailer parts inventory of a manufacturer's distribution warehouse in Mississauga. Draw-Tite, Reese, Tekonsha, Fulton, Bulldog, Rola, plus Hyundai/Kia/Toyota OEM programs and Luber-finer filtration. Hundreds of pallets, sold whole to one buyer.
WHAT'S IN IT (photographed stock alone — there is more on the floor that wasn't photographed): Hitch receivers — Draw-Tite / Reese, hundreds loose and boxed, incl. Ultra Frame heavy-duty. Fifth-wheel & gooseneck hardware, Pro Series 12,000 lb units, Bulldog 25,000 lb couplers. Winches & jacks — 150-count bulk winch gaylord, Fulton winches, Bulldog jacks by the gaylord.
